title: Schedule Note — Reinvestment Tolerance on the Class H Preferred Stock Quarterly Purchase Allowance, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The quarter-limit reinvestment tolerance of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock purchase rests on the holding's reinvestment record: at least 8 reinvested dividend entries give USD 4000; at least 4 but fewer than 8 give USD 2000; fewer give none.

| Reinvested dividend entries on the holding | Quarter-limit reinvestment tolerance |
|---|---|
| 8 or more | USD 4000 |
| 4 to 7 | USD 2000 |
| 0 to 3 | None |

All reinvested dividend entries over the life of the holding are counted. The tolerance is a dollar amount added to the quarter's purchase allowance before the excess is taken.

**Edges (hypothetical holdings).** 3 entries give none; 4 give USD 2000; 7 give USD 2000; 8 give USD 4000.
